scope: v0.26.5 RC5 attempt 36 fixes the remaining RC4 Recomps navigation bug proven by the user screenshot. Preserve all validated RC4 manual multi-game persistence, exact-EXE selection, remove-without-delete behavior and all RC3 rendering/naming/controller/browser/streaming/GameCube/downloads/installer fixes. Recomps must no longer enter the generic platform/provider experience at all. Selecting the Recomps tile from Games must route directly to the dedicated RecompsLibrary subpage and must not produce PlatformChoice, ProviderStore, PlatformHome, PlatformShelf, PlatformLibrary, Home/Shelf/Library/Install & Manage choices, provider management rails, folder-source controls, refresh/scanning UI, or storefront install/update/verify/move/uninstall semantics. The dedicated RecompsLibrary page must expose Add Recomp Game, Back to Platforms and the complete persistent list of manually added recomp games. Add Recomp Game must select exactly one .exe, append one separate RecompGames record without replacing prior games, reject duplicate executable paths, show .exe files only, and return directly to RecompsLibrary after selection. Each saved game must open the dedicated RecompsGame page with Launch when the exact executable exists, Open Folder, Remove from Recomps and Back only. Launch must execute the exact saved LaunchTarget directly through Start-ExternalProcess and never enter Legendary/gogdl/Nile, provider workers or emulator routing. Remove must require native confirmation, remove only the selected Huymaier Console record and stale recent/favorite references, preserve all executable/game files, and return to RecompsLibrary. Back from RecompsGame returns to RecompsLibrary; Back from RecompsLibrary returns to the platform shelf. Any stale navigation state from older builds including PlatformChoice, ProviderStore, PlatformHome, PlatformShelf, PlatformLibrary or ProviderGame must normalize safely to the new simple Recomps pages so the old UI cannot reappear. The final Recomps owner must load after V7 and wrap the actual post-V7 Render-GamesHub, Invoke-Action, Handle-Back, Get-PageDefinition and picker/confirmation owners rather than restoring pre-V7 snapshots. Retired Recomps root-folder settings and folder scanning remain absent. Preserve HC3D v2 mirrored winding, D3D11 face culling/double-sided behavior, authored UV/sampler fixes, full-screen viewer orientation, shared model brightness, PS4/Sega CD/NES/SNES canonical naming, Xbox PC versus Original Xbox isolation, V7 native D3D11 shelves, frozen emulator console selection and frozen PS1/PS2/PS3 behavior. Exact-source validation must include the permanent Test-v0265-RecompsDirectLibrary gates proving tile-to-library routing, no PlatformChoice, no ProviderStore, exact-EXE picker return, simple game page and remove-without-delete, plus the full existing Platform Models, Unified Cursor, Performance, Download Refresh and GameCube suites. Staged release validation must require the packaged HuymaierRecompsFinal.ps1 simple-library owner, post-V7 load order, RecompGames native persistence, EXE-only picker, no folder scan, direct library routing and explicit stagedManualRecompsDirectLibraryGate/stagedManualRecompsNoPlatformChoiceGate/stagedManualRecompsNoProviderStoreGate successes. Then require x64 FSE host build, installer rollback/tamper/failure injection, stabilization, staged cursor/streaming/GameCube/V7, active-download stability, Steam owned-library behavior and final SHA verification. Upload only if every gate succeeds and the candidate request parent exactly equals production_source d886e0e60796184a25da042a6e3021fef5b15160.
